paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the BLEU score performance of four different models as a function of Average Lagging (AL), which ranges from 0.0 to 10.0 on a linear scale along the x-axis, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, also on a linear scale, ranging from 18 to 28 with tick marks at intervals of 2. The red line with star markers, labeled "Consistency-Bi", starts at approximately 22.0 BLEU at AL=0.0 and increases to about 28.5 BLEU at AL=10.0, showing a steady upward trend. The blue dashed line with square markers, labeled "Inconsistency-CE-MP", begins at 18.5 BLEU at AL=0.0 and rises to approximately 27.0 BLEU at AL=10.0. The purple dashed line with square markers, labeled "Inconsistency-CE", starts at 19.0 BLEU at AL=0.0 and increases to about 26.5 BLEU at AL=10.0. The light purple dashed line with circle markers, labeled "Consistency-CE", begins at 19.0 BLEU at AL=0.0 and rises to approximately 26.0 BLEU at AL=10.0. All four lines show an increasing trend in BLEU score with increasing Average Lagging, with "Consistency-Bi" consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across all AL values.
